scripts.text:
[Alora]
Hello, I can change your headgear's color if you bring me a Mysterious Dyestuff.
scripts.translation:
[阿洛拉]
你好，如果你给我神秘染料，我可以改变你头饰的颜色。

scripts.text:
[Alora]
Do you have a headgear that you would like to dye?
scripts.translation:
[阿洛拉]
你有想要染色的头饰吗？

scripts.text:
[Alora]
Have a good journey adventurer!
If you ever are curious to try a new color on your Kafra headgear or the ones you found on your adventures please come to me!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛拉]
祝你旅途愉快，冒险者！
如果你想给你的卡普拉头饰或是在冒险中获得的头饰换个新颜色，欢迎随时来找我！

scripts.text:
[Alora]
Okay, what color do you want to change it to?
scripts.translation:
[阿洛拉]
好的，你想把它改成什么颜色？

scripts.text:
[Alora]
Oh I'm so excited aren't you?
And just to be sure, what color is the {0} you want me to use?
scripts.translation:
[阿洛拉]
哦，我太兴奋了，你呢？
再确认一下，你想让我使用的{0}是什么颜色的？

scripts.text:
[Alora]
Please understand that I'm going to use the ^FF00001st {0} of that color in your inventory!^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿洛拉]
请理解，我将使用你背包中该颜色的^FF0000第一个{0}！^000000

scripts.text:
[Alora]
Any upgrades and cards will be dissolved by the mysterious dye, so be sure you are ok with having a ^0000FF+0 {0} without any cards.^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿洛拉]
任何精炼和卡片都会被神秘染料溶解，所以请确保你接受得到一个^0000FF+0且没有插卡的{0}。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok, thanks for the warning, I think I'll give you my
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，谢谢提醒，我想我把我的

scripts.text:
[Alora]
It's best to be very sure, have a safe journey.
scripts.translation:
[阿洛拉]
最好再三确认，祝你一路平安。

[阿洛拉]
哇，发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Alora]
Oh my, you seem to be missing something.
scripts.translation:
[阿洛拉]
天哪，你好像少了什么东西。

scripts.text:
[Alora]
Looks great doesn't it?!
I hope you'll come back to dye more pretty headgears!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛拉]
看起来很棒不是吗？！
希望你以后还会回来给更多漂亮的头饰染色！
